# Azure (Azure Kubernetes Service)

This directory contains all Azure-specific code for deploying an AKS cluster with Kasten K10 data protection.

* [k8s-tf/](./k8s-tf): Terraform code to provision an AKS cluster, VNet, Blob Storage, Key Vault, and optionally bootstrap ArgoCD with GitOps-managed applications.
* [argocd/](./argocd): ArgoCD application and addon manifests. The majority of these files are auto-generated by Terraform.
